citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:30 PM on 12-
August-2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the facility door, calling the phone number
on file, and leaving a voice message. The licensee returned the inspectors call at 1:47 PM and stated that he was
currently exhibiting in Findlay, OH and that he was unavailable for inspection. Failure to provide access to the facility,
animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is
serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Eric Irvin, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
